bio: Ariana Leroux is a Licensed Senior Mortgage Broker with DLC Brokers for Life (Dominion Lending Centres), serving Spruce Grove, Edmonton, St. Albert, Sherwood Park and Parkland County, and clients across Canada. The site says she accesses over 30 lenders and covers pre-approvals, renewals, first-time buyers, new builds, self-employed, newcomers and complex cases. She supports the Edmonton Food Bank and JCI Holiday Hamper Program.
